LanguageData.MT_ShieldStatusTip: Current shield energy / maximum capacity. This shield protects only this turret. Power is required for protection and recharging.
LanguageData.MT_ShieldStatusEmergencyTip: Paragon emergency recharge triggers when the shield is depleted. EMP does not trigger it, and it does not absorb the remaining damage of the hit that depleted the shield.
LanguageData.MT_ShieldRechargeRules: Each absorbed hit resets the recharge delay to 5 seconds. Depletion or EMP sets a 20-second delay. After the delay, a powered turret restores 1/120 of its maximum shield per second.
